strategies = {'대당효과 순': ('대당효과', False), '보유율 낮은 순': ('저상율', True), '이용객 많은 순': ('승하차', False)}

def cum_curve(col, asc):
    d = route.sort_values(col, ascending=asc)
    return d['미저상대수'].cumsum(), d['해소효과'].cumsum()
In [31]:
for name, (col, asc) in strategies.items():
    x, y = cum_curve(col, asc)
    plt.plot(x, y, label=name)
plt.xlabel('투입 저상버스 대수')
plt.ylabel('불편 해소 인원')
plt.title('전략별 누적 해소 효과')
plt.legend()
plt.show()
In [32]:
def resolved(col, asc, budget):
    x, y = cum_curve(col, asc)
    return y[x <= budget].max() / route['해소효과'].sum()

budgets = [100, 300, 500, 800]
pd.DataFrame({name: [resolved(col, asc, b) for b in budgets] for name, (col, asc) in strategies.items()}, index=budgets).round(3)
